newsitem.title: CHINA: China expressway sells stake to foreign interests.
newsitem.headline: China expressway sells stake to foreign interests.

text.p: A Chinese developer is financing a 5.4 billion yuan ($651 million) expressway in China's southern province of Hainan by issuing shares and selling some of them to foreign shareholders, a company official said on Friday.
The 172-km (107-mile) expressway links Haikou, the provincial capital of Hainan, and Tongshi city, an official of the Hainan Kaili Development and Construction Co Ltd said by telephone.
The official declined to give the value of the company's share capital. He also declined to identify the foreign interests or say how big a stake they had taken.
The Hainan provincial government would take over the expressway upon completion and compensate shareholders with either cash or land, the official said.
The expressway would begin construction next February and was due to be completed in six to eight years.
He declined to provide further details.
